create_Dataset_subclass: create a subclass of Dataset that implements benchmark_uris and benchmark_from_parsed_uri methods
install_Dataset: install a Dataset locally by calling the install method on a Dataset instance
uninstall_Dataset: uninstall a Dataset and remove its site data by calling the uninstall method
enumerate_benchmark_uris: enumerate all benchmark URIs in a Dataset by calling the benchmark_uris method
select_benchmark_by_uri: select a specific Benchmark from a Dataset using its URI string or bracket notation
